bounds.basis: Inherited 1400 kg/s is agent assumption A3; 1600 is derived from Lyon 2916 MW over Raffray Fig. 12 cycle temperatures 355 to 707 C at cp 5193 (1595 kg/s); 1500/1700/1800/2000 bracket the response.
bounds.missing_response: No machine map, purchased flow capability or cycle pressure-loss law responds to cycle flow; compressor rating screen is the only reachable check.

bounds.basis: Raffray Table V prints 283 kg/s; inherited 500 kg/s is agent assumption A4.
bounds.missing_response: Divertor hydraulics and MHD are unqualified; the cubic pump proxy is bypassed by the fixed-power mode in every case that changes this flow.

bounds.basis: Model meaning: fraction of charged power deposited in the blanket circuits, remainder to the divertor. Inherited 0.25 is assumption A1. Lyon Table IV prints 98.1 MW to the divertor of 487 MW charged power; Raffray Table V implies 66.8 MW of nuclear heating in the divertor at 2365 MW (186 minus 24 friction, 23.6 conducted, 23.6 alpha loss, 48 radiated), 68.8 MW scaled to 2436 MW. Divertor deposition 167 MW gives 1 minus 167/487.2 = 0.657; the nuclear share is carried as charged power because the model has no divertor nuclear-heating term.
bounds.missing_response: No radiation, scrape-off-layer or neutron transport model resists the partition.

bounds.basis: Raffray Table II: 111 MW conducted from PbLi to He at 2365 MW fusion, 0.0469 of fusion power; inherited 0.04 is assumption A1.
bounds.missing_response: No insert-conductance model resists the exchange.

bounds.basis: Mode 0 is the inherited series arrangement (helium, then divertor, then PbLi in one cycle stream; WI-089). Mode 1 represents Raffray Fig. 12 (p. 741): the blanket-helium exchanger first, then the PbLi and divertor-helium exchangers in parallel on split cycle flow, rejoining before the turbine (WI-092 design, reviewed).
bounds.missing_response: No branch hydraulic balance, header or pressure-loss law resists the arrangement; the split between the parallel stages is supplied.

bounds.basis: Fraction of cycle flow through the PbLi stage in mode 1; no source states it. Raffray duty shares (1444 MW PbLi, 186 MW divertor; Tables II and V) imply about 0.89 for equal branch temperature rises; the design default is 0.85; 0.50 to 0.98 brackets the response. Ignored in mode 0.
bounds.missing_response: No valve, header or branch hydraulic model responds to the split; a split that starves a branch shows as unmet heat on that branch, never as manufactured transfer.

bounds.basis: Inherited 1600 MW offered compressor capacity is assumption A6 (WI-089). The separately named resized-compressor alternative sets the rating to 1700 or 1800 MW alongside the same cycle flow; it is a declared hardware change studied for its purpose and never a reference reproduction.
bounds.missing_response: No compressor map or purchase-cost response; the rating is the scalar offered-capacity screen against the calculated compressor demand.

bounds.basis: Raffray Table II prints 3261 kg/s for the 2365 MW case; the reference-case contract § 8 scales duties to 2436 MW by 1.030 while the flow was held at 3261; 3359 kg/s is that flow scaled with the duty (contract § 6a, Q1 review finding 2). A supplied operating flow, never derived from demand.
bounds.missing_response: No blanket hydraulic or MHD law responds to the flow; the helium pump power is supplied fixed (Lyon 170 MW) in these cases.

bounds.basis: Raffray Table II prints 26,860 kg/s; 27,666 kg/s is that flow scaled by 1.030 with the duty (contract § 6a). A supplied operating flow, never derived from demand.
bounds.missing_response: No PbLi hydraulic or MHD law responds to the flow; the PbLi pump proxy is 0.01 MW at reference and negligible here.

bounds.basis: The helium pump offered flow capacity carried along with the scaled flow (3261 → 3359 kg/s) so that the mapping does not trip the pump screen by construction; a declared purchased value of the scaled mapping, stated here rather than sized from demand.
bounds.missing_response: Scalar capacity screen only; no pump map.

bounds.basis: The PbLi pump offered flow capacity carried along with the scaled flow (26,860 → 27,666 kg/s); same reasoning as he_pump_capacity.
bounds.missing_response: Scalar capacity screen only; no pump map.
